```{r make_count_data, eval = FALSE}
data_path_cells <- "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/_molecular_mechanisms_of_ACx_lateralization/data_ACx_cells"
count_data <- wispack::make_count_data(
  data_path = data_path_cells,
```

Now make summary stats, for each mouse 

```{r summary_stats, eval = FALSE}
# Extract summary statistics (mean, variance, summed counts) from data
# ...  it will return a list holding two data.frames formatted like those imported below from the csv files
summary_stats_from_data <- function(
    obs_data         # data frame, columns as barcodes (genes or blanks), rows as cells, elements as spot counts
  ) {
    
    # Extract summary statistics
    observed_rates         <- colMeans(obs_data)
    observed_variance      <- rep(NA, length(observed_rates))
    for (i in 1:length(observed_variance)) {
      observed_variance[i] <- sd(obs_data[,i])^2
    }
    observed_counts        <- colSums(obs_data)
    
    # Collect summary stats
    data <- data.frame(
      rates    = observed_rates,
      variance = observed_variance,
      counts   = observed_counts
    )
    rownames(data) <- colnames(obs_data)
    
    return(data)
    
  }

mice <- unique(count_data$mouse)
mice_masks <- lapply(mice, function(m) count_data$mouse == m)
count_data <- count_data[,13:(ncol(count_data)-6)]
summary_stats_data <- data.frame(mouse = c(), rates = c(), variance = c(), counts = c())
for (i in seq_along(mice_masks)) {
  ss <- summary_stats_from_data(count_data[mice_masks[[i]],])
  ss <- cbind(mouse = i, ss)
  summary_stats_data <- rbind(summary_stats_data, ss)
}
write.csv(
  summary_stats_data,
  file = "/Users/michaelbarkasi/projects_Oviedo_lab/R_packages/flipFISH/inst/extdata/summary_stats_all_mice.csv",
  row.names = TRUE
)
```

Now try new function. 

```{r new_initial_estimate}
t <- Sys.time()
resids <- dichot_guass_benchmark(
    m1_summary_stats,                        # Numeric matrix with rows as barcodes, columns labeled "rates", "variance", "counts", must have barcode names as row names
    codebook,                                # Codebook with row names as barcodes and columns as bits, must have barcode names as row names
    n_sims                           = 10,   # 100
    n_forks                          = 20,
    max_flips                        = 4,    # Suggest min of 6, 7 or 8 better
    report_freq                      = 10,
    maxeval                          = 100,   # Suggest min of 100, 150 or 250 probably better
    max_correctable_Hamming_distance = NULL
    )
d <- Sys.time() - t
units(d) <- "secs"
cat("\ntime:", d, "seconds\n")


```


```{r} 

pred_resids <- colMeans(resids[["fr_est"]])
#pred_resids <- resids[["fr_est"]][1,]
stip <- resids[["fr_stipulated"]]
l <- length(stip)
plot(stip[1:56], pred_resids[1:56])
plot(stip[57:l], pred_resids[57:l])
fr_cor <- cor(stip[1:56], pred_resids[1:56])
corr_cor <- cor(stip[57:l], pred_resids[57:l])
n <- 1000
shuffled_cors_fr <- rep(NA, n)
shuffled_cors_corr <- rep(NA, n)
for (i in 1:n) {
  shuff <- sample(57:l, l-56, replace = FALSE)
  shuffled_cors_corr[i] <- cor(stip[shuff], pred_resids[57:l])
  shuff <- sample(1:56, 56, replace = FALSE)
  shuffled_cors_fr[i] <- cor(stip[shuff], pred_resids[1:56])
}
fr_p <- sum(abs(shuffled_cors_fr) >= abs(fr_cor))/n
corr_p <- sum(abs(shuffled_cors_corr) >= abs(corr_cor))/n
cat("\nfr_cor:", fr_cor)
cat("\ncorr_cor:", corr_cor)
cat("\nfr_p:", fr_p)
cat("\ncorr_p:", corr_p)
```


```{r} 

pred_ppv <- colMeans(resids[["PPV_est"]])

pred_counts <- colMeans(resids[["sim_counts"]])
#pred_ppv <- resids[["PPV_est"]][1,]
stip <- resids[["PPV_expected"]]
stip_ecc <- resids[["ecc_expected"]]
l <- 719
plot(stip[1:l], pred_ppv[1:l])
plot(stip_ecc[1:l], pred_ecc[1:l])
plot(stip_ecc[1:l], pred_counts[1:l])
ppv_cor <- cor(stip[1:l], pred_ppv[1:l])
ecc_cor <- cor(stip_ecc[1:l], pred_ecc[1:l])
counts_cor <- cor(stip_ecc[1:l], pred_counts[1:l]) 
n <- 1000
shuffled_cors <- rep(NA, n)
shuffled_cors_ecc <- rep(NA, n)
shuffled_cors_count <- rep(NA, n)
for (i in 1:n) {
  shuff <- sample(1:l, l, replace = FALSE)
  shuffled_cors[i] <- cor(stip[shuff], pred_ppv[1:l])
  shuffled_cors_ecc[i] <- cor(stip_ecc[shuff], pred_ecc[1:l])
  shuffled_cors_count[i] <- cor(stip_ecc[shuff], pred_counts[1:l])
}
ppv_p <- sum(abs(shuffled_cors) >= abs(ppv_cor))/n
ecc_p <- sum(abs(shuffled_cors_ecc) >= abs(ecc_cor))/n
count_p <- sum(abs(shuffled_cors_count) >= abs(ecc_cor))/n
cat("\nppv_corr:", ppv_cor)
cat("\nppv_p:", ppv_p)
cat("\n")
cat("\necc_corr:", ecc_cor)
cat("\necc_p:", ecc_p)
cat("\n") 
cat("\ncount_corr:", counts_cor) 
cat("\ncount_p:", count_p)
```

```{r}

library(ggplot2)

plot_fr_histograms <- function(n, resids, bins = 30) {
  fr_est <- resids[["ecc_est"]]
  fr_stipulated <- resids[["ecc_expected"]]

  stopifnot(is.matrix(fr_est))
  stopifnot(length(fr_stipulated) == ncol(fr_est))

  n <- min(n, ncol(fr_est))

  for (j in seq_len(n)) {
    df <- data.frame(value = fr_est[, j])

    p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = value)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = bins, color = "black", fill = "grey80") +
      geom_vline(
        xintercept = fr_stipulated[j],
        color = "red",
        linewidth = 1
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Column", j),
        x = "Estimated flip rate",
        y = "Count"
      ) +
      theme_bw()

    print(p)
  }
}

plot_fr_histograms(50, resids, 10)



```
